name: folder-arrow-down
description: A complete folder containing a complete down arrow.
useCase: Move a folder into a selected child directory.
misuse: Label the folder action explicitly; arrows depict fixed physical directions.

16.reason: The full shared folder and tab stay unchanged; the complete content marker sits in its open body with clear gaps. The filled arrowhead has tangent rounded corners.

24.reason: The full shared folder and complete content marker retain their direction and generous separation. The filled arrowhead has tangent rounded corners.
